story_title: As an Event Coordinator, I want to submit a venue booking request for an event so that Venue Staff can review whether the venue can be made available

acceptance_criteria.text: The Event Coordinator can select a suitable venue.
The request specifies one or more of the venue's fixed AM, PM or Night slots for the required date; an event spanning multiple slots consumes each of them in full.

Where setup or turnaround time is required, the immediately adjacent slot (before the event for setup, after for turnaround, including the previous or following day where applicable) is included in the request.
For a multi-session event, a booking request is made per session, using that session's own date, time and requirements rather than the event's.
The request is associated with the relevant event (and session, where applicable).
Venue requirements are included in the request.
The request is submitted to Venue Staff for review.
The venue booking request has a pending status.

test_cases.title: Coordinator requests a suitable venue, with venue requirements and layout

Run npm run fixtures:spm42.
Logged in as Coordinator Daniel Tan (daniel.tan@connectsphere.com / password123), assigned to spm42_symposium 'SPM42 Research Symposium' (status Planning, 4 Mar 2027 (2026-09-26 + 159) 09:00-18:00, expects 200, layout Theatre, no sessions).
Changi Conference Centre (CBP-CONF) has Theatre capacity 260.
steps: Open the Venue tab (Find a venue)
Find 'Changi Conference Centre (CBP-CONF)' in the results
Type the text below into 'Venue requirements'
Log out, log in as Venue Staff Marcus Wong (marcus.wong@connectsphere.com / password123) and click 'Booking Requests' in the sidebar
test_cases.test_data:
Event: SPM42 Research Symposium
Venue: Changi Conference Centre (CBP-CONF)
Date: 4 Mar 2027 (2026-09-26 + 159)
Slots: AM, PM
Venue requirements: Lectern and stage riser at the front; two wireless microphones; doors open 08:30.
test_cases.expected_result:
Changi Conference Centre is shown as Suitable.
The booking request screen opens for 'SPM42 Research Symposium' at 'Changi Conference Centre (CBP-CONF)'.
After submitting, 'Booking request sent to Venue Staff.' is shown.
Marcus Wong sees the request with Layout 'Theatre' and the requirements exactly as typed.

test_cases.title: Setup and turnaround each take exactly one adjacent slot, including the previous or following day
test_cases.preconditions:

Orchard Seminar Room (ORC-SEM): setup 60 min, teardown 30 min. Changi Conference Centre (CBP-CONF): setup 120 min, teardown 90 min.
steps: Open the Venue tab (Find a venue)
Tick the slots for the date
Read the setup and turnaround lines
test_cases.test_data:
1. spm42_early_briefing 'SPM42 Early Briefing', 8 Mar 2027 (2026-09-26 + 163) 09:00-12:00, Orchard Seminar Room, AM
2. spm42_late_show 'SPM42 Late Show', 9 Mar 2027 (2026-09-26 + 164) 19:00-22:00, Orchard Seminar Room, Night
3. spm42_networking 'SPM42 Networking Evening', 11 Mar 2027 (2026-09-26 + 166) 17:00-22:00, expects 120, Banquet, Changi Conference Centre, PM + Night

Each request is sent and holds exactly its chosen slots plus those two.

test_cases.title: Slots that do not cover the session's (or event's) own time are refused

Logged in as Daniel Tan, assigned to spm42_three_sessions 'SPM42 Three-Session Forum' (Day 2: 2 Mar 2027 (2026-09-26 + 157) 14:00-17:00) and to 'SPM42 Refusal Checks' (7 Mar 2027 09:00-17:00, no sessions).

Tick only 'AM (07:00–12:00)' for 2 Mar 2027 and click 'Submit request'

Open 'SPM42 Refusal Checks', open the Venue tab and click 'Request booking' on 'Orchard Seminar Room (ORC-SEM)'

open_questions: The Jira issue was not fetched (the Atlassian connector is not authenticated). Story and AC1-AC8 were copied from Jira by hand on 2026-10-01.

The booking request screen is not built yet. Every label ('Request booking', 'Submit request', 'Session', 'Venue requirements'), the setup/turnaround lines and every quoted message are proposed wording. Build to these strings, or update the cases.
Is 'Venue requirements' optional? TC03 assumes it is.

Opening hours are not checked: a Night slot or a setup/turnaround slot can fall when the venue is closed (Orchard Seminar Room closes 22:00, Night runs to 24:00 - TC06 attempt 2). Should a request be refused or warned? Cases assume it is accepted.
A single-session event that runs over more than one day cannot be covered by a one-date request (the team says such an event needs sessions). What should the coordinator see? No case written.

Suitability is checked when the request is submitted. If the event's attendance or layout changes afterwards, nothing re-checks the Pending request. Should it be flagged like SPM-39's needsReview? No case written.
Cases that submit requests use spm42_ fixture events, so npm run fixtures:spm42 resets them for a repeat pass. Never reseed the shared database for these cases.
